PRIVATE HIGHER EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS ACT 1996

PRIVATE HIGHER EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (CONDUCTING COURSES OF STUDY)

(AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 88 of the

Private Higher Educational Institutions Act 1996 [Act 555], the Minister makes the

following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Private Higher Educational

Institutions (Conducting Courses of Study) (Amendment) Regulations 2017.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 28 November 2017.

Amendment of regulation 3

2. Regulation 3 of the Private Higher Educational Institutions (Conducting Courses

of Study) Regulations 1997 [P.U. (A) 546/1997], which are referred to as the

"principal Regulations" in these Regulations, is amended—

(a) in subregulation (2)—

(i) by inserting after the word "application" the words "under

subregulation (1)"; and

(ii) by deleting the words ", and one copy to the Chief Executive of

Lembaga Akreditasi Negara,";

(b) in subregulation (3), by substituting for the words "The application for

each of study" the words "The application under subregulation (1) for

each course of study"; and

(c) by substituting for subregulation (4) the following subregulation:

"(4) The application under subregulation (1) shall be accompanied

by—

(a) a certificate of provisional accreditation issued by the

Malaysian Qualifications Agency under Part VII of the

Malaysian Qualifications Agency Act 2007 [Act 679] and any

conditions imposed by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency

relating to the certificate of provisional accreditation; and

(b) any other documents as determined by the Registrar General.".

Amendment of regulation 4

3. Regulation 4 of the principal Regulations is amended—

(a) in paragraph (a), by substituting for the word "taught" the word

"conducted";

(b) in paragraph (b), by substituting for the words "teaching and learning" the

word "conducting"; and

(c) in paragraph (d), by substituting for the word "Minister" the words

"Registrar General".

Amendment of regulation 5

4. Regulation 5 of the principal Regulations is amended—

(a) by substituting for subregulation (1) the following subregulation:

"(1) Where the Registrar General is satisfied with the application for

conducting courses of study or additional courses of study under

regulation 3, the Registrar General may approve the application.";

(b) by inserting after subregulation (1) the following subregulation:

 "(1A) Upon approval of the application under subregulation (1), the

applicant shall pay the approval fee to the Registrar General as specified in

the Second Schedule."; and

(c) in subregulation (2)—

(i) by substituting for paragraph (a) the following paragraph:

"(a) five years where the duration of the courses of study or

additional courses of study is three years or below; and";

and

(ii) by substituting for paragraph (b) the following paragraph:

"(b) seven years where the duration of the courses of study or

additional courses of study is more than three years.".

Amendment of regulation 6

5. The principal Regulations are amended by substituting for regulation 6 the

following regulation:

"Renewal of

approval.

6. (1) An application for renewal of the approval to conduct a

course of study or an additional course of study shall be made in

Form ‘C' in the First Schedule.

(2) The application under subregulation (1) shall be

submitted to the Registrar General not later than six months prior to

the expiry of the approval to conduct the course of study or

additional course of study.

(3) The application under subregulation (1) for each course

of study or additional course of study shall be made in a separate

application form.

(4) The application under subregulation (1) shall be

accompanied by—

(a) a certificate of accreditation issued by the Malaysian

Qualifications Agency under Part VIII of the

Malaysian Qualifications Agency Act 2007 and any

conditions imposed by the Malaysian Qualifications

Agency or the relevant professional body relating to

the certificate of accreditation; and

(b) any other documents as determined by the

Registrar General.

(5) Where the Registrar General is satisfied with the

application under subregulation (1), the Registrar General may

approve the application.

(6) Upon approval of the application under subregulation (5),

the applicant shall pay the approval fee to the Registrar General as

specified in the Second Schedule.".

New regulation 6A

6. The principal Regulations are amended by inserting after regulation 6 the

following regulation:

"Application

for variation

or alteration

of

conditions.

6A. (1) An application for variation or alteration any of

the conditions imposed by the Registrar General under

subsection 40(1) or 40A(4) of the Act shall be made in Form ‘D' in

the First Schedule.

(2) The application under subregulation (1) shall be

submitted to the Registrar General.

(3) The application under subregulation (1) for each course

of study or additional course of study shall be made in a separate

application form.

(4) The application under subregulation (1) shall be

accompanied by—

(a) any conditions imposed by the Malaysian

Qualifications Agency or the relevant professional

body under Part VIII of the Malaysian

Qualifications Agency Act 2007; and

(b) any other documents as determined by the

Registrar General.

(5) Where the Registrar General is satisfied with the

application under subregulation (1), the Registrar General may

approve the application.".

Amendment of regulation 7

7. Regulation 7 of the principal Regulations is amended by substituting for the

words "the decision of the Minister" the words "his decision".

Amendment of regulation 8

8. The principal Regulations are amended by substituting for regulation 8 the

following regulation:

"Amendment

of certificate of

registration.

8. (1) A private higher educational institution shall submit to

the Registrar General the certificate of registration issued under

subsection 24(9) of the Act within six months after the

Registrar General—

(a) approves an application for conducting an

additional course of study under

subregulation 5(1);

(b) approves an application for renewal of the approval

to conduct a course of study or an additional course

of study under subregulation 6(5);

(c) approves an application for variation or alteration

of the conditions imposed by the Registrar General

under subregulation 6A(5);

(d) makes under subsection 40(1F) of the Act any

variation, cancellation or alteration of, or addition

to, any of the conditions referred to in

subsection 40(1) of the Act; or

(e) imposes under subsection 40A(4) of the Act new

conditions or makes any variation, cancellation or

alteration of, or addition to, any of the conditions

referred to in subsection 40(1) of the Act.".

Amendment of regulation 8A

9. Regulation 8A of the principal Regulations is amended by substituting for the

word "Minister" the words "Registrar General".

Substitution of First Schedule

10. The principal Regulations are amended by substituting for the First Schedule the

following Schedule:
